crux: depth (approach) rate dZ/dt of the pelvis at frame 11->12; the in-plane part (~1.5 m/s) is agreed
fault_found: C1 (and the submitted blend) took the depth rate from bbox height (~6e-3/frame, legs straightening f9-14); SIFT rigid upper-body scale gives 1.5-2e-3/frame; r=6e-3 in the same geometry reproduces C1's 3.29
lesson: When verifying a proposed depth rate from apparent scale, rerun it with a feature-matching method different from the one used before (e.g. multi-pair SIFT least squares instead of ECC or templates); if both rigid-part methods agree and differ from whole-silhouette extents, the silhouette route is the faulty one.
